sources.title: [2503.14734] GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist ...
sources.snippet: A robot foundation model, trained on massive and diverse data sources, is essential for enabling the robots to reason about novel situations, robustly handle real-world variability, and rapidly learn new tasks. To this end, we introduce GR00T N1, an open foundation model for humanoid robots.
